```{r setup, include=FALSE, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(readr)
library(tidyverse)
library(psych)
library(kableExtra)

d <- read_csv("OSF_teacher_study_coded_FRs.csv")
```

```{r}
d_a <- read_csv("crime_rater1_IRR.csv")
d_e <- read_csv("crime_rater2_IRR.csv")

d_a <-
  d_a %>%
  mutate(crimecurious = as.factor(crimecurious),
         crimecurious_collapsed = if_else(crimecurious == 1, 1, 2))

d_e <-
  d_e %>%
  mutate(crimecurious = as.factor(crimecurious),
         crimecurious_collapsed = if_else(crimecurious == 1, 1, 2))

# after transformation, double check everything is in the same order.
table(d_a$participant_id == d_e$participant_id)

# cohens kappa - crime curious, unweighted estimate 
Rater1 <- d_a$crimecurious
Rater2 <- d_e$crimecurious
cohen.kappa(x = cbind(Rater1, Rater2))

# cohens kappa - crime curious collapsed
Rater1 <- d_a$crimecurious_collapsed
Rater2 <- d_e$crimecurious_collapsed
cohen.kappa(x = cbind(Rater1, Rater2))
```

# Code Definitions
**Crime Curious**  
Do they want to know about *the reason the student was in JD*?  
Excludes **that** they were incarcerated, includes **why** they were incarcerated  
Responses could get 1, 2, or [3 and/or 4]. If they get both 3 and 4, primary is what comes first (top of mind), after asking about why they were incarcerated.  

1.  **Not curious** They don’t mention it / don’t want to know  
2.  **Curious w/o Reason** They think about it / want to know but don’t imply why  
3.  **Curiousity Supports Student** They think about it / want to know and this is **in service of supporting the student** (in their transition).   
    * If they wonder about incarceration due to behavioral problems/violence and knowing this is to support the student
4.  **Curiosity Protects Others** They think about it / want to know and this is **in service of protecting themselves/others from the student**  
    * If they wonder about incarceration due to behavioral problems/violence and don’t imply what knowing this is in service of, then assume it is to protect others  


# Basic code outcomes
```{r include=FALSE}
# convert as factor
d <-
  d %>% 
  mutate(crimecurious = as_factor(crimecurious))
```

## Descriptives
### Crime Curious
```{r}
table(d$crimecurious, d$condition) %>% 
  kbl(caption = "Crime Curious") %>% 
  kable_material(c("striped", "hover"))

prop.table(table(d[d$condition == "control",]$crimecurious)) %>% 
  kbl(caption = "Crime Curious Overall Proportion - CONTROL") %>% 
  kable_material(c("striped", "hover"))

prop.table(table(d[d$condition == "letter",]$crimecurious)) %>% 
  kbl(caption = "Crime Curious Proportion - LETTER") %>% 
  kable_material(c("striped", "hover"))

```

### Crime Curious Binary
```{r echo=FALSE}
table(d$crimecurious_binary, d$condition) %>% 
  kbl(caption = "Crime Curious Binary") %>% 
  kable_material(c("striped", "hover"))

d %>% 
  summarise(crime_binary = mean(crimecurious_binary, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  kbl(caption = "Overall Proportion") %>% 
  kable_material(c("striped", "hover"))


d %>% 
  group_by(condition) %>% 
  summarise(crimecurious_binary = mean(crimecurious_binary, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  kbl(caption = "Overall Proportion by Condition") %>% 
  kable_material(c("striped", "hover"))

```


## Visualizations 
### Crime Curious 
```{r echo=FALSE}

d %>% 
  select(crimecurious, condition) %>% 
  na.omit(crimecurious) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = crimecurious)) + 
  geom_bar(aes(fill = condition), position = position_dodge(width = .9), width = 0.8) +
  ggtitle(label = "Count of teachers with differing curiosity") +
  theme_classic() +
  ylab("") +
  xlab(" ") +
  theme(axis.line = element_line(),
         axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

```

### Crime Curious Binary 
```{r echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

d %>% 
  select(crimecurious_binary, condition) %>% 
  ggplot(mapping = aes(x = condition, y = crimecurious_binary, fill = condition)) + 
  stat_summary(fun.y = mean, geom = "bar", position = "dodge") + 
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_cl_boot, geom = "errorbar",
               position = position_dodge(width = 0.90), width = 0.3) +
  ggtitle(label = "Proportion of teachers who are curious about the crime of student in re-entry") +
  theme_classic() +
  xlab("Condition") +
  ylab("") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

## Analysis
### Crime Curious
```{r}
chisq.test(d$crimecurious, d$condition) 
```

### Crime Curious Binary
```{r echo=FALSE}
summary(glm(crimecurious_binary ~ condition, data = d, family = binomial))  

chisq.test(d$crimecurious_binary, d$condition) 
```
